statement: Newborn sleep courses sell expectations and soothing primers at premium prices (Taking Cara Babies newborn bundle $99; Moms on Call 0–6-month course $99; Huckleberry Plus $9.99/mo, Premium $14.99/mo with custom plans), with graduated-check-in tiers that cross into sleep training for babies 5 months and older.
evidence: Taking Cara Babies newborn bundle page; Moms on Call 0–6 course page; Huckleberry pricing page. All accessed 2026-09-17.
